_about: Every tunable number in GWF RPG Edition. Each entry is {v, unit, spec, note}. The GM config screen edits these per room; docs/BALANCE.md is generated from this file by tools/build-balance-doc.mjs. Game code reads values through packages/shared/balance.js and never hard-codes them.

maxPlayers.note: Room cap. Map, monsters and loot are tuned for 4 to 6.

tunedMin.note: Lower end of the player count the auto-scaling targets.

tunedMax.note: Upper end of the player count the auto-scaling targets.

targetRunMinutes.note: Auto-scaling aims a full map at this length; Short is ~60, Long ~120.

proxyAfterSeconds.note: A phone silent this long hands its prompts to the GM console.

lastCallMinutes.note: Last Call: a run still going this long after RUN_START ends on placings (score, then kills). 0 turns it off.

maxAtLevel1.note: Max Health of a fresh character.

flatStart.note: Starting Health when the GM skips the Buy-in Wheel.

tellHigh.note: Above this fraction of max the lantern burns full.

tellLow.note: Below this fraction the lantern is almost out.

gritReducePerPoint.note: Damage taken reduced per Grit point.

greedStreakBonus.note: Damage multiplier added per Greed point while on a win streak.

nerveClockSeconds.note: Shot clock seconds added per Nerve point above 3.

monsterMissTurns.note: Turns missed after dying to a monster.

playerMissTurns.note: Turns missed after dying to a player or boss.

wakeFraction.note: Health on waking at the Graveyard.

playerKillLevelLoss.note: Levels lost when killed by a player or boss.

wornDropsOnMonsterDeath.note: Random worn items dropped on a monster death (plus the whole grid).

tileLootRounds.note: Loot left on a tile stays this many rounds before it is swept.

collectorPerTurn.note: What the Collector takes each turn a pact is overdue.

greedInterestPerPoint.note: Extra interest per Greed point above 3.

ironSetFraction.note: Interest multiplier with the Iron four-piece bonus (halved).

collectorFloor.note: The Collector never takes a character below this Health.

perKO.note: Gold paid by the bank for a KO.

scorePerKill.note: Score per kill in the Free-for-all tiebreak.

startingGold.note: Gold a fresh character starts with.

shopSellFraction.note: The Shop buys back at this fraction of price.

robberyMaxFraction.note: A Robbery may name up to this share of the target's Gold.

wantedTurns.note: How long a failed robber is Wanted.

arenaCrowdBonus.note: Crowd bonus paid to the Arena winner.

chestGold.note: Gold from a Chest when the Loot Wheel lands on Gold, at region tier 1.

chestGoldPerTier.note: Extra Chest Gold per region tier above 1.

bountyMin.note: Smallest bounty a player may post at a Bounty Board.

petWin.note: XP for a pet battle win.

perLevelBase.note: XP needed from level 1 to 2; each level needs this much more than the last.

upgradeLevels.note: Levels that unlock a stronger class active.

titleDamage.note: Damage dealt for Glass Cannon and taken for Punching Bag.

titleBosses.note: Bosses beaten for the Dragon Slayer title.

titleTurns.note: Turns survived without dying for the Undying title.

titlePets.note: Pets caught for the Tamer title.

titleGold.note: Gold earned for the Tycoon title.

titleCrits.note: Critical hits for the Sharpshooter title.

titleChallenges.note: Challenge Wheel wins for the Duelist title.

titleDeaths.note: Deaths survived for the Lazarus title.

neutral.note: Lever pivot: each point above improves the game's odds, each point below worsens them.

creationStart.note: Every stat starts here at creation.

creationCap.note: Highest a stat can reach at creation.

clockSeconds.note: Creation clock; unlocked players get the safe allocation at zero.

greedPayoutPerPoint.note: Creation payouts rise this much per Greed point.

bloodHealthPerChip.note: Max Health staked per chip in the Blood option.

bloodMax.note: Most max Health the Blood option may stake.

safePointPerChip.note: Unstaked chips become this many stat points each.

gambleGames.note: Games a stat may be gambled on: the starter kit's three plus a Buy-in Wheel spin.

buyinMultipliers.note: The eight segments of the Buy-in Wheel when it is played as a creation gamble (chips × segment).

perTurnSeconds.note: Added to a player's clock at the start of their turn.

bankCapSeconds.note: Unused time banks up to this.

warningSeconds.note: The clock-warning sound plays with this much left.

timeoutSlackMs.note: A TURN_TIMEOUT appended this close to zero is accepted (covers clock skew between the TV and the backend).

stakeCommon.note: Stake of a Common weapon or spell.

charges.note: Charges on a dropped weapon or spell. Spec default 5; raised to 15 after bot runs (at 5, a Common weapon dies inside one monster fight and the table runs out of weapons).

affixesLegendary.note: Affixes on a Legendary, plus its unique.

legendaryPerRun.note: Most Legendaries that drop in one run.

starterPotions.note: Potions in the starter kit (with Coin Blade, Loaded Dice, Mend).

critXpMultiplierThreshold.note: A result at or above this fraction of the game's top multiplier is a crit.

leverPenaltyPerPoint.note: Threshold levers ("at 5", "at 6") have no graded downside, so below the neutral stat each point instead trims win payouts by this fraction.

monsterStakeFraction.note: Tuned 1.0 → 0.6 after bot runs. A monster stakes this fraction of its item's stake on its own moves (its Health is the stake pool).

setDropChance.note: Chance an armour drop (helmet, torso, pants, boots) is a Blockcraft set piece instead of a rolled base.

tierScale.note: Affix strength rises this fraction per region tier above 1.

oddsUses.note: Extra peeks, rerolls or safe picks an Odds affix grants per use of the named game.

economyGold.note: Extra Gold from KOs on a Greedy (Economy) affix.

economyXp.note: Extra XP on a Studious (Economy) affix.

economyRarity.note: Loot rarity shift in the named region on a Fortunate (Economy) affix.

helmetNerveSeconds.note: Shot clock seconds on the Helmet utility affix.

torsoMaxHealth.note: Max Health on the Torso utility affix while worn.

pantsStakeCap.note: A losing stake costs at most this much Health with the Pants utility affix.

glovesPeeks.note: Free hidden-pick peeks per night on the Gloves utility affix.

vaultPull.note: Items pulled from the vault at setup.

cardRange.note: Card boots look this far for a colour.

cardRangeExtended.note: Card range with the range6 boots affix.

cardNoMatchStep.note: Steps when no hex of the colour is in range.

halfStopDice.note: Dice that may stop only after half the roll.

fullWalkDice.note: Dice that must walk the full roll.

colourDoubles.note: Double cards in the colour deck (one per colour).

bossGateBounce.note: Bounce back when the Boss Gate refuses you.

regionHexesShort.note: Hexes per region at Short size for the tuned table.

regionHexesRegular.note: Hexes per region at Regular size.

regionHexesLong.note: Hexes per region at Long size.

hexesPerExtraPlayer.note: Spec 2; 0 after bot runs: every player gets fewer turns at a bigger table, so the map must not grow with them. Region hexes added per player above the tuned minimum.

monstersPerRegion.note: Monsters rolled per region at the tuned table. Spec 3; 2 after bot runs (plus the boss) keeps a Regular map inside two hours.

monstersPerExtraPlayer.note: Monsters added per player above the tuned minimum.

citadelLevel.note: Level needed to enter the Sky Citadel without a key.

calderaDamageMult.note: Damage multiplier both ways in The Caldera.

citadelLootShift.note: Loot rarity shift in the Citadel.

regionBiasWeight.note: Extra weight on a region's favoured family when rolling drops.

fogOfWar.note: Reveal regions on the TV as players enter them.

healthCommon.note: Health of a standard region monster at tier 1. Spec 60; 40 after bot runs so a monster dies inside two or three turns of Common hits.

healthBoss.note: Health of a region boss at tier 1. Spec 200; 140 after bot runs.

healthRaid.note: Health of a raid boss at tier 1. Spec 320; 240 after bot runs.

healthFinal.note: Health of the Dealer. Spec 400; 260 after bot runs.

tierScale.note: Monster Health and damage rise this fraction per difficulty tier.

pitBossReduce.note: Pit Boss takes this much less from monsters.

hitCapFraction.note: No single monster hit takes more than this fraction of a character's max Health (0 turns the cap off). Added after bot runs: bosses one-shot level-1 characters.

raidMinPlayers.note: Players needed on the tile to start a raid.

snareThreshold.note: Tamer's Snare catches below this Health fraction.

lootGoldTierScale.note: Monster Gold drops rise this fraction per difficulty tier above 1.

eggChanceScale.note: Multiplier on every species' egg drop chance (0 turns eggs off).

timeoutDamage.note: Both take this when the timer runs out with no result.

noRepeatMinEntries.note: With at least this many enabled entries the same one cannot repeat in a fight.

gmWindowSeconds.note: After a spin the GM sees the result this long before the TV animation; reroll or force within it.

winMult.note: The winner's weapon hits for stake times this, no roll.

critMult.note: A flawless win is a crit: the hit uses this multiplier instead.

seriesWins.note: Wins needed in a team (best-of-three) entry.

quickdrawMinDelayMs.note: Quick-Draw: shortest wait before the TV flashes.

quickdrawMaxDelayMs.note: Quick-Draw: longest wait before the TV flashes.

quickdrawFlawlessMs.note: Quick-Draw: a winning reaction at or under this is flawless.

speedMathQuestions.note: Speed Math: questions per duel; first to answer them all correctly wins.

triviaQuestions.note: Trivia: questions drawn from the bank per duel.

memoryPairs.note: Memory Match: pairs in the grid (6 pairs = 4 by 3).

emojiSequenceLength.note: Emoji Memory: length of the full sequence; reaching it is flawless.

typingMaxErrors.note: Typing Race: a submission with at most this many errors counts as finished.

startPower.note: Power of a freshly hatched pet.

sessionPowerBonus.note: Power every pet gets at the start of a run.

rareWheelBlanks.note: Dud-egg segments on the rare pet wheel.

beastmasterPowerMult.note: Beastmaster pets earn Power at this multiple.

beastmasterAttackBonus.note: Beastmaster pet attack bonus at level 10.

evolveAt.note: Power thresholds at which a pet reaches its second and third stage.

winPower.note: Power a pet earns when one of its attacks wins.

battleMaxRounds.note: Pet-versus-pet battles end after this many rounds; higher Power left wins.

wheelSegments.note: Segments on each of the three pet wheels.

lettersOffTurn.note: Letters you may write when it is not your turn.

smokeBombFree.note: Free Smoke Bombs for the Cutpurse per run.

sideBetsOn.note: Side bets for players not in the fight.

tableVotesPerNight.note: Table votes to send someone to the Graveyard.

letterMaxChars.note: Longest letter a phone may send.

sideBetMax.note: Largest side bet a spectator or bystander may place.

voteSeconds.note: How long a vote stays open when the opener names no deadline.

emoteKeep.note: Emotes kept for the TV to float over avatars.

whaleStakeDiscount.note: Whale weapon stakes cost this much less.

whaleDamageBonus.note: Whale hits deal this much more.

enforcerKillHeal.note: Enforcer heals this on a player kill at level 10.

croupierSpellDiscount.note: Croupier spells stake this much less.

upgradedCooldown.note: Cooldown after the level-20 upgrade for Whale and Cutpurse.

whaleCritBonus.note: Whale crit multiplier bonus at level 5.

pitBossShopDiscount.note: Pit Boss shop discount at level 10.

cutpurseHiddenTurns.note: Turns the Cutpurse is hidden on the TV after a Smoke Bomb.

croupierCardsBonus.note: Croupier Cards family bonus at level 5.

bugPotions.note: Bug Reward Wheel: Round of Potions.

bugMaxHealth.note: Bug Reward Wheel: Patched Up adds this much max Health for the run (and heals to full).

chaosRegionRounds.note: Length of a region-targeted Chaos effect.

chaosGridShrinkRounds.note: Rounds a Chaos grid shrink lasts.

lootWeightLegendary.note: Loot Wheel weight of Legendary (subject to the per-run cap).

luckRarityShiftPerPoints.note: Luck points per one-step rarity shift.

fateMissTurns.note: Turns lost on the Fate Wheel's Lose a Turn.

chaosClassRounds.note: Length of a class-targeted Chaos effect.

tiers.note: Difficulty tiers; each unlocks by clearing the one before.

tierLevelBand.note: Width of each tier's level band; a veteran cannot enter a tier below its band.

legendaryTier.note: Deepest tier; Infernal Mantle is awarded for clearing it without dying.

scorePerHealth.note: Score per point of Health remaining in the Free-for-all tiebreak.

pvpChestMult.note: PvP only: chest tiles per region are multiplied by this (no monsters, more loot).

pveExtraMonsters.note: PvE only: extra monsters rolled per region.

pedestalLevel.note: Pedestal Blade cannot be drawn under this level.

pedestalReach.note: Pedestal Blade reach at full Health.

emberCharges.note: Ember Flask charges after an Inn.

broadsideMovePenalty.note: Movement lost while wielding the Broadside.

potencyStats.note: Amulet of Potency bonus to all stats.

fairyRevive.note: Fairy in a Jar revive fraction.

poolDamage.note: Health lost per turn in the pool.

cameraDamage.note: Camera Obscura damage to a revenant or wraith.

pedestalFullHealth.note: Health fraction counted as full for the Pedestal Blade.

coatMinStake.note: The Croupier's Coat: opponents must stake at least this much against the wearer.

giltCharges.note: Fights a Gilt piece survives before it crumbles.

itemLegendary.note: Price a Legendary sells back from (never stocked).

cutpurseConsumableFraction.note: What a Cutpurse pays for Fork and Nudge (half).

restockRounds.note: A Shop refills its shelf this many rounds after it was first opened.

tierDamageMult.note: Damage multiplier per Chaos tier (tiers 1 to 5).

tierUpEveryRounds.note: Chaos tier rises every this many rounds.

collectorTakes.note: What the Collector takes when Chaos sends them.

regionMult.note: Damage multiplier of a region-targeted Chaos effect (double damage in the Docks).

classMult.note: Damage multiplier against a Chaos-marked class.

voteSeconds.note: How long the table has to vote a Chaos victim.

perRun.note: Public quests dealt at the start.

holdGold.note: Gold to hold for the hoarder quest.

bankGold.note: Banked Gold needed for the banker quest.

winsInRegion.note: Hits landed in the named region for the regional quests.

monsterKills.note: Monster kills for the hunter quest.

surviveChaosTier.note: Chaos tier to be alive at for the survivor quest.

houseCut.note: Share of the winning bid the house keeps when a player sells at auction.

shrinkEveryRounds.note: Rounds between map shrinks in Royale.

outsideDamage.note: Damage per turn outside the circle.

minRadius.note: The circle never shrinks closer than this to the throne.
